rows.commentary: 0.1: Marco Jansen drops it in sharply, clattering off Maddinson's pad and racing down to the boundary for four leg byes to get Australia moving.
0.2: Dot ball from Marco Jansen to Maddinson.
0.3: Dot ball from Marco Jansen to Maddinson.
0.4: Marco Jansen targets a fuller channel outside off, prompting a forward stride from Maddinson to push it securely toward cover.
0.5: Marco Jansen finds late lateral movement away from Maddinson, who hangs back and flashes hard at thin air as the ball sniffs the edge.
0.6: Dot ball from Marco Jansen to Maddinson.
1.1: Travis Head does not score off Wiaan Mulder.
1.2: Wiaan Mulder drifts onto the pads, and Travis Head punishes the indiscretion with a crisp boundary.
1.3: Wiaan Mulder delivers from back of a length, angling it across Travis Head, who covers the line and lets it pass.
1.4: Wiaan Mulder pitches full around off, and Travis Head eases the drive softly towards mid-off where Bavuma executes a sharp stop.
1.5: Wiaan Mulder finds his ideal rhythm with a probing good-length delivery outside off, which Travis Head meets squarely behind the line with a straight bat.
1.6: Wiaan Mulder darts a full, swinging delivery into the batter, prompting Travis Head to step across and softly turn it toward mid-wicket.
2.1: Dot ball from Marco Jansen to Maddinson.
2.2: Marco Jansen drops it short at 132.5ks, angling it away past off stump as Maddinson watches it sail through untouched.
2.3: Marco Jansen pushes the pace up to 139.7ks on a length outside off, prompting Maddinson to drop back and tap it gently to backward point.
2.4: Marco Jansen attacks with a 138.5ks nip-backer that catches Maddinson lunging forward, zipping past the inside edge to thud into the back thigh.
2.5: Marco Jansen angles one down the leg side, and Maddinson misses the connection entirely on the attempted glance.
2.6: Marco Jansen hovers it at 134.5 clicks swinging away outside off, and Maddinson wisely raises his bat to watch it through.
3.1: Wiaan Mulder drops it fuller with inward swing, but Travis Head trusts the pitch's bounce to leave it alone just outside the off-stump.
3.2: Wiaan Mulder dials it down to 131.2 clicks, angling it across for Travis Head to dead-bat into the empty cover region for a single.
3.3: Wiaan Mulder floats a fuller 130.5kph offering near the channel, and Maddinson punches it cleanly toward mid-off.
3.4: Wiaan Mulder attacks the same channel with a fuller length, inducing Maddinson to lunge forward before an inside edge deflects it sharply into the pad.
3.5: Wiaan Mulder rattles Nic Maddinson with a sharp appeal for leg-before, but Richard Kettleborough remains unmoved as a double noise echoes through the middle.
3.6: Wiaan Mulder gets the ball swinging down leg, catching Maddinson off guard as he fails to glance it away and wears it on the underside of his thigh pad.
4.1: Marco Jansen charges in at one hundred forty-four point five kph, spearing it full and down the leg side as Travis Head attempts the flick and watches it glance off the pad for leg byes.
4.2: Marco Jansen keeps it full around the off stump, finding Maddinson rooted to his crease as he dead-bats the ball softly into the off-side.
4.3: Marco Jansen angles one in short and forces it away, beating Maddinson underneath the blade as the batsman remains stranded without a run and visibly rattled.
4.4: Marco Jansen sends down a good length delivery at 138.7ks that tails away outside off, and Maddinson watches it sail through.
4.5: Marco Jansen drifts a 141.1ks full ball down the leg side, missing the glance off Maddinson's pads before Verreynne gathers it low.
4.6: Marco Jansen angles one into the leg stump, catching Maddinson on the pad as the batter collapses trying to flick.
5.1: Wiaan Mulder lands it full and tails it sharply into the pads, leaving Travis Head to stride forward and nudge it squarely into the mid-wicket region.
5.2: Wiaan Mulder digs it in at one hundred and thirty-four clicks on the leg-line, inducing an early closure of the bat face from Travis Head as the leading edge dribbles tamely out to mid-on.
5.3: Travis Head does not score off Wiaan Mulder.
5.4: Wiaan Mulder steams in from his mark at a sharp 130.4 kilometers per hour, targeting the sticks with a probing full length, and Travis Head simply nudges it quietly toward the mid-on fielder.
5.5: Wiaan Mulder chases a sharp inward angle down the leg-side, beating Travis Head's glance as the ball ricochets off the thigh pad toward fine leg for an extra run.

5.6: Wiaan Mulder spears through a 131.3 kilometre-per-hour nip-backer that pins Maddinson to his crease, clipping the batsman's thigh pad after beating the inside edge and scuttling past gully for a leg bye.
6.1: Maddinson does not score off Marco Jansen.
6.2: No run for Maddinson off Marco Jansen.
6.3: Marco Jansen probes wide outside off with a sharp short ball, leaving Maddinson swinging vainly as the ball flashes past Verreynne just shy of first slip.
6.4: Marco Jansen attacks the batsman with another probing delivery at 139.1 clicks, forcing Maddinson to watch it sail through safely.
6.5: Marco Jansen extracts late movement away from the right-hander at 135kph, prompting Maddinson to withdraw his bat with absolute disdain.
6.6: Marco Jansen thinks he has locked down an immaculate fourth consecutive maiden, but the third umpire's sirens wail for a front-foot no-ball as Maddinson watches it sail past.
6.6: Marco Jansen curls another delivery harmlessly away past the channel, leaving Maddinson completely untroubled as he shoulders arms once more.
7.1: Wiaan Mulder applies immediate pressure with a disciplined opening delivery, locking Travis Head down in his crease.
7.2: Wiaan Mulder delivers a full length swinging into the pads, and Travis Head dispatches it far wide of the desperate shouts for a catch to race away to the boundary for four.
7.3: Mulder lands this good length delivery on a threatening line, angling inward as Head swishes across the line and wears it squarely on the thigh pad.
7.4: Travis Head does not score off Wiaan Mulder.
7.5: Wiaan Mulder captures the breakthrough as Travis Head edges behind to give Kyle Verreynne a sharp catch, ending a nine-run stay that included two boundaries.
7.6: Wiaan Mulder steams in to Marnus Labuschagne, angling it into the pads and flicked down to fine leg for a single.

9.5: Wiaan Mulder lands it on a length with a hint of late away-movement, allowing Marnus Labuschagne to pull his bat high and watch it pass.

21.3: Mulder delivers on a good length, angling across the right-hander as Smith watches it pass without offering a shot.

22.1: Maharaj floats it up into the right-hander, and Smith drops to one knee to sweep it fine, scampering back industriously for the second run.
22.2: Maharaj tosses it on an off-stump line, prompting Smith forward to push firmly towards the fielder stationed at silly mid-off.

22.5: Maharaj imparts drift away from the right-hander, tempting Steven Smith who watches the flight pass safely wide.
22.6: Maharaj floats another delivery outside off, and Smith dead-bats it straight back down the pitch.
